title: Adjustable-angle phone stand
prompt: A desk phone stand holding a phone at 60°: 80 mm wide cradle with a 12 mm lip, cable slot in the base, weighted footprint so it doesn't tip when tapped.
lesson: Adjustable-angle phone stand — farmed pattern for "phone"-class prompts. Judge 80/100.
code:
from build123d import *
from math import sin, cos, radians

# ---- Desk phone stand @ 60 deg ----
cradle_w = 80.0            # phone cradle width
angle = 60.0              # phone lean from horizontal
backrest_t = 6.0          # thickness of the leaning back plate
backrest_h = 90.0         # length of the back plate along lean
lip_h = 12.0              # front lip that stops the phone sliding
lip_t = 6.0
phone_gap = 12.0          # clearance between lip and backrest (phone thickness slot)

base_l = 95.0            # base footprint depth (front-to-back)
base_w = cradle_w + 16   # base width
base_h = 16.0            # base height (weighted plinth)
wall = 3.0

cable_slot_w = 16.0
cable_slot_h = 9.0

fillet_big = 6.0
fillet_med = 2.0
edge_break = 1.0
base_chamfer = 1.0

a = radians(angle)

with BuildPart() as stand:
    # ---- weighted base plinth ----
    b = Box(base_w, base_l, base_h, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    fillet(stand.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), fillet_big)

    # ---- back rest that leans at 60 deg ----
    # foot sits toward the back of the base
    foot_y = -base_l / 2 + backrest_t + 6
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ):
        # profile in Y-Z, then extrude across width
        with Locations((foot_y, base_h - 2)):
            Rectangle(backrest_t, backrest_h, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
                      rotation=-(90 - angle))
    back = extrude(amount=cradle_w / 2, both=True)

    # ---- front lip to catch the phone ----
    # place lip a phone-gap in front of the backrest foot, measured along base
    lip_y = foot_y + phone_gap + backrest_t / 2
    with Locations((0, lip_y, base_h)):
        lip = Box(cradle_w, lip_t, lip_h, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # ---- cradle floor between lip and backrest (support ledge) ----
    ledge_y = (foot_y + lip_y) / 2
    with Locations((0, ledge_y, base_h)):
        Box(cradle_w, phone_gap + backrest_t, wall,
            align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # ---- cable slot through the cradle floor + front of base ----
    with Locations((0, lip_y - lip_t / 2 - 3, base_h - cable_slot_h / 2 + 4)):
        Box(cable_slot_w, base_l, cable_slot_h, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- edge treatment ----
    # base plate build edge chamfer (anti elephant-foot)
    chamfer(stand.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[0], base_chamfer)
    # break top exposed base edges
    top_edges = stand.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1].edges()
    # soften lip top edges
    fillet(lip.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[-1], fillet_med)
    # soften backrest free-end edges
    fillet(back.edges().filter_by(Axis.X).group_by(Axis.Z)[-1], edge_break)

result = stand.part
